cues: There is a neat physical reason.
The refracted wave sets the electrons in the glass vibrating, across the refracted ray.
A vibrating charge radiates nothing along its own line of vibration.
At Brewster's angle, the reflected direction lies exactly along that line for the vibrations in the plane of incidence.
So that component cannot be reflected, and only the perpendicular one survives.
